Product Description

When It Comes To Running, The Response Pace Running Shoes Are Your Go-To Partners. Designed For Those Who Embrace The Road, These Shoes Offer A Blend Of Comfort And Performance That Inspires You To Keep Moving Forward.The Cloudfoam Midsole Offers A Holistic Comfort Experience From Step-In To Stride. Designed With Extra Cushioning For An Ultra-Soft Step, It Supports You On Your Running Journey.The Breathable Mesh Upper Adapts To Your Foot, Providing Support While Keeping You Feeling Dry During Your Run. With A Full-Length Rubber Outsole, You Can Trust In Reliable Grip And Stability On Varied Surfaces.The Adidas Brand Name Is Synonymous With Quality, And These Shoes Are No Exception. Whether You're Running A Marathon Or Enjoying A Leisurely Jog, These Shoes Are Built To Support Your Active Lifestyle.

Amazon Customer
5 out of 5 stars
Great outsole, true to size and comfortable
I’ve purchased three pairs of the Adidas Response Pace Sneakers so far: two in red, which is my favorite color, and one in gray. I really like these shoes, especially the thick, durable outsole, which makes them great for walking and being on my feet all day at work. I pair these shoes with WalkHero rigid insoles for plantar fasciitis pain relief, and together they provide the comfort and support I need to get through a full workday on my feet. The shoes fit great and are true to size. Although the Response Pace comes with Cloudfoam cushioning, I remove the original insole and use my WalkHero insoles instead. The WalkHero insoles fit perfectly without any trimming, and I use the same size insole as the shoe. Overall, I’m very happy with these sneakers. They’re comfortable, fit well, and have a thick outsole that holds up well for all-day walking. I’ll definitely continue purchasing them, especially when they go on sale!

  • Cycling Through Life
    5 out of 5 stars
    Good pair of athletic shoes for the price
    Reviewed in the United States on March 16, 2026
    Size: 9Color: Dark Blue/Matte Silver/Black
    Verified Purchase
    Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
    Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

    I will start off by saying that I'm not a runner. I do go to the gym a lot, and one of the things I do there is the step mill machine (stairclimber) and the treadmill. I also do a lot of walking (10k steps) in my neighborhood from time to time. I got these shoes for that purpose.

    While I don't mind paying good $$$ for a decent pair of shoes, the last pair of shoes I paid good $$$ didn't last all that long. In fact, its outer sole was equally as thin as those on the cheaper shoes. With that said, this time around I was a little more budget conscious, and wanted the best quality shoe for the price.

    I found these here, and after reading the product description and some online reviews, I decided to try them.

    The shoe fit is true to size. It wasn't too tight or too loose, even with thick socks on. The insole was comfortable and even after an hour of walking around doing everyday stuff, my feet felt pretty good. The insoles felt good and comfortable, although I have plantar fasciitis so I will wait and see how that goes after a longer period of wearing. The outer sole is rubber and felt firm and grippy.

    This shoe adds about an inch to inch and a quarter of height to my frame. My other shoes were somewhere in the order of half an inch to three quarters of an inch. The top part of the shoe is a mesh like fabric cloth, and allows for some breathability on a hot day. The overall quality of the shoe is pretty decent, and I detect no flaws in the craftsmanship.

    I am pleased with the shoe upon my initial experiences. Time will tell how the shoe holds up. But in the meantime, I am happy with it. For what I paid ($42), this is a pretty decent pair of athletic shoes. I can't speak to its performance for running, but for my intended use in the gym, this shoe fits the bill quite well without breaking the bank.

    These shoes are comfortable, stylish, and honestly better‑made than I expected — but let’s talk about the color. The listing said dark gray, but when I opened the box, my first thought was, “Ah yes… the rare and majestic Lavender Gray, found only in nature and certain 90s windbreakers.”

    Don’t get me wrong, they look good. They just look good in a soft‑purple‑ish, lavender‑leaning, gray‑adjacent kind of way. If you’re expecting a storm‑cloud gray, you might be surprised. If you’re cool with a little unexpected flair, these will treat you right.

    Comfort? Solid. Style? On point. Color accuracy? Let’s just say the shoes and the product description are living in slightly different realities.

    Still keeping them — because apparently I’m now a lavender‑shoe guy, and honestly, I’m not mad about it.
